name: Michelle Harrison
bio:
Michelle Harrison's journey into motorsport began not on the track, but in her father's auto repair shop in rural Ohio. Surrounded by engines and tools from a young age, she developed a keen understanding of mechanical systems and a passion for optimizing performance. This early exposure fueled her decision to pursue a degree in Mechanical Engineering, where she excelled in thermodynamics and fluid dynamics.

After graduating, Michelle landed a position with a small IndyCar team, quickly rising through the ranks due to her sharp analytical skills and ability to troubleshoot complex issues under pressure. Her meticulous approach to data analysis and her knack for identifying subtle improvements in vehicle setup have earned her a reputation as a detail-oriented and innovative engineer. She approaches her role with a relentless pursuit of perfection, always seeking marginal gains that can translate to significant on-track advantages. 

Michelle joined Sodi Kart Factory five years ago, bringing a wealth of experience to the team. She distinguishes herself with a proactive and collaborative leadership style, fostering open communication and knowledge sharing among her engineering staff. Her ambition drives her to push the boundaries of karting technology, always striving to develop cutting-edge solutions that give Sodi Kart an edge over the competition.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy, usually tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Michelle has a focused expression and a practical, no-nonsense demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a multi-tool in her pocket, even on non-race days.
Has a habit of sketching out mechanical diagrams on napkins during meetings.
Insists on starting every race day with a cup of black coffee and a detailed weather report.
